title: Learning a New Board Game
context: Mia 到朋友 Alex 家参加桌游之夜，两人边玩边解释规则。本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，题目为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: This game looks fun, but I've never played it.
dialogue.zh: 这个游戏看起来很有趣，但我从没玩过。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: It's easy to learn. The goal is to reach the castle first.
dialogue.zh: 很容易学。目标是第一个到达城堡。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Do we each choose a piece?
dialogue.zh: 我们每个人选一个棋子吗？

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Yes. Pick a color, then put your piece at the start.
dialogue.zh: 对。选一种颜色，然后把棋子放在起点。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: I'll take green. Who goes first?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: You can. Roll the die and move that many spaces.
dialogue.zh: 你先吧。掷骰子，掷出几点就走几格。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: I got three. What does this star mean?
dialogue.zh: 我掷了三点。这个星星是什么意思？

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: It means you pick a card and follow the instructions.
dialogue.zh: 意思是你抽一张卡并按上面的说明做。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: My card says to move forward one space.
dialogue.zh: 我的卡片上说向前走一格。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Nice! Now it's my turn. I got two.
dialogue.zh: 不错！现在轮到我了。我掷了两点。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: I think I understand now. This is more fun than reading all the rules first.
dialogue.zh: 我想我现在明白了。这比先读完所有规则更有趣。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: I'm glad. Let's keep playing and see who reaches the castle!
dialogue.zh: 很高兴你这么觉得。我们继续玩，看看谁先到城堡！

expressions.example: The goal is to collect five cards.
Would you like to go first?
Roll the die to begin your turn.
It's my turn to choose a song.

pronunciation: castle 中的 t 通常不发音，重音在第一个音节；die 的元音与 day 不同。

practice.title: Part 1 · Games
practice.prompt: Do you enjoy playing board games?
practice.answer: Yes, especially with a small group of friends. I like games that are easy to learn and give everyone a chance to talk.

practice.title: Part 2 · A game you learned
practice.prompt: Describe a game you learned to play. Say who taught you, how it worked, and whether you enjoyed it.
practice.answer: My friend taught me a board game at her apartment last winter. Each player chose a colored piece and tried to reach a castle. We rolled a die, moved along the board, and sometimes picked cards. At first I was worried about remembering the rules, but she explained them as we played. I enjoyed the game because we could laugh and talk between turns. We played again before I went home. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Playing together
practice.prompt: What can people learn from playing games together?
practice.answer: They can practice taking turns and explaining their ideas. Games can also show people how to deal with winning and losing while still enjoying time together.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读后介绍一款简单游戏，说明目标、如何行动以及什么时候轮到别人。
practice.answer: The goal is to reach the end. Roll the die and move your piece. Then it's my turn.
